Rural Georgia Asset Quality & Constraint Explorer

99 counties across Regional Commissions 6–12, scored on 92 public indicators mapped to 29 community-asset sub-assets in eight domains — then tested for whether their constraints bundle, and whether those bundles can be sequenced.

Draft
This is a working draft, circulated for comment. The scores, constraint classifications and bundle typology are all provisional and the underlying framework is still being refined. Feedback is most useful on three things: whether the county rankings match what you see on the ground, whether the five constraint bundles describe real patterns in your region, and whether anything important is missing from the eight asset domains — particularly the sub-assets listed as unmeasured under Method & gaps. Send comments to alfie@economicimpact.com, or read the methodology memo first.
Built August 2026 from American Community Survey 2019–2023, County Business Patterns 2013 & 2023, the 2022 Census of Governments, LEHD LODES 8 (2023), BLS LAUS 2019–2025, Census Population Estimates and Building Permits, CDC PLACES 2024, CMS Hospital Compare and TIGER 2024. Scores are relative measures within the 99-county study area, not absolute judgements of any community.
